events.text_en: The road wardens of Lam Yên give up the road through Cổ Dịch Trấn: every spring the forest takes back a li of it, and the road is moved east.
Ngu Lam Sơn ends his hundred days in the haze at the empty inns of Cổ Dịch Trấn, and gives his first order as head: 'We go down.'
Thúy Vi Tông carries its halls down from the founder's ridge to Cổ Dịch Trấn. Cù Thúy Bách stays with the founder's pine, and the old seat becomes the Cliff Hall.
Ngu Lam Sơn finds the child of Ẩn Loan cove eating kelp on the beach and carries her up to the ridge; the sect names her Diêm Hải Tảo, for the salt and the weed.
Hướng Đông Lâm, Warden of the Cold Ford, will not leave the quay of Hàn Tân and dies beside his lamp; the fishers hide the lamp.
Tân Hàn Chu takes forty disciples across the river-mouth ice at night under Tùng Đào's arrays; the ice breaks.
Tất Hành Vụ teaches the Haze Walk to his sworn brother, a road guard of the cape.
Ngu Lam Sơn plants three plots of the Heir's Garden and gives them to Thiệu Thanh Đài, Hoàn Cô Bách and Hướng Vãn Chu; he will judge them in 1205.
Peach petals come down a forest stream to Lăng Giác Thôn in spring. A disciple follows them and comes back three days later with no memory of the three days.
Úy Thanh Diễm forms his Nascent Soul over the Green Furnace, which does not go out.
Six of Tùng Đào's border patrol do not come back from the river-mouth ice of the Cold Ford; Tùng Đào lists them as deserters.
On the Green Door Day a baby is left on the step of Thúy Vi's door in Lam Yên Thị, wrapped in green inner-gate silk.
